title: Krishna Ella's Uneasy Return to Make a Cheap Hepatitis B Vaccine
conflicts: Who urged the return: wife only (Deccan Chronicle 2000, Business Today 2004) vs wife and mother (2011 onwards, incl. his own 2014 article); both given in order. Launch: Jan 1999 with trial production Oct 1998 (2000 interview, Ella 2014) vs 1998 (BioSpectrum 2003, New Indian Express 1999); story uses the 2000 dates. Prior price: Rs 1,400 a dose (BioSpectrum 2003), USD 35-40 (UW 2011), Rs 1,012 per child (BioSpectrum 2011); story gives Rs 1,400 and the Rs 800 first selling price with sources, and does not claim a one-dollar launch price.
notes: Covaxin and later products deliberately left out. Two founder-interview texts are retyped copies hosted in Bharat Biotech press archive (PDFs load but the checker cannot read names in them); their key claims are his own words or confirmed by BioSpectrum. Stance complicates.
